Messages.Author: Zenedar
Messages.Body:
Hello! I'm wondering if Mata Hari can play cards like these new ones from the Danse Macabre:

Mata Hari
[aus]
[for]
[qui]
[CHI]
[OBF]
[Ravnos] Ravnos

Capacity: 7

Group: 4

Independent. Red List: Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may play cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect and/or clan.

Public Vilification
[Political Action] Political Action

Requires a titled Sabbat vampire.
Choose a younger ready vampire controlled by another Methuselah. Successful referendum means this vampire steals 3 blood from the chosen vampire.

Under Siege
[Action] Action

[1 Pool]

+1 stealth action. Unique. Requires a titled Sabbat vampire.
Put this card in play with 3 counters. Once each action, a Sabbat vampire you control can burn 1 counter from this card to untap and attempt to block with +1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed. Burn this card when it has no counters.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
No, she can't. There is nothing in her text about mimicking titles.

Jussi Hattara
Webmaster Extraordinaire
Finnish  Politics!

Messages.Author: Zenedar
Messages.Body: Alright thanks for clearing that up. I was confused because I thought she could play it as she is titled already and could use her special to play cards from different sects.

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: But she IS titled already, they don't specify requiring a sabbat title, just a titled sabbat vampire, she is titled and can mimic the sabbat part. Of course she can't actually use the untap effect provided by Under Siege, since once the card is in play it doesn't see her as sabbat vampire anymore.

Messages.Author: Zenedar
Messages.Body: So you're saying she CAN infact play them?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> a picture of each printing of said card(we dint have the resources for this, afaik)
>
www.vtes.pl

Shove the card you want into "Karta". Say, Arika. You get back a list of every printing of the card. On hover (and on click-through to that page), you can see a copy of the card in that printing.

(FWIW, I occasionally use this when trying to unpick a ruling from the 1990s that was based on random text. Like trying to work out what the hell was going on with Obedience, which changed text - badly - several times.)
